newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem stands by Ecuador's Bucaram.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem stands by Ecuador's Bucaram.

text.p: Argentina's President Carlos Menem declared support on Friday for Ecuador's Abdala Bucaram, who was declared mentally unfit by Congress to continue as president.

"President Menem expresses his firmest support for the constitutionally elected president of Ecuador, Abdala Bucaram, trusting in the prompt resolution of the challenges facing that country, with which Argentina maintains ties of brotherly friendship," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.
Menem was following events with concern but held the "conviction that the spirit of democracy, peace and national conciliation would prevail," the Foreign Ministry said.

Bucaram refused to recognise Thursday's congressional vote deposing him and is now one of three contenders claiming to be president. Congress swore in its speaker, Fabian Alarcon, to replace Bucaram, and Bucaram's vice president, Rosalia Arteaga, issued a decree proclaiming herself head of state.
Elsewhere, the Brazilian government said it was watching events in Ecuador with concern.

"Brazil has full confidence that the government, political leaders and the Ecuadorean people will be able to overcome the challenges the country faces with serenity and within the democratic order," a statement from the Foreign Ministry said.
